widget.name: Speedometer
widget.description: howing speedometer like gauge using d3.

property.caption: value
property.description: Make sure your value is between your minValue and maxValue. Default is 0

property.caption: minValue
property.description: Min Value. Default is 0

property.caption: maxValue
property.description: Max Value. Default is 1000

property.caption: forceRender
property.description: After initial rendering/mounting, when props change, only the value is changed and animated to maintain smooth visualization. But, if you want to force rerender the whole component like change in segments, colors, dimensions etc, you can use this option to force rerender of the whole component on props change. Default is true.

property.caption: currentValueText
property.description: Should be provided a string which should have ${value} placeholder which will be replaced with current value. By default, current value is shown (formatted with valueFormat). For example, if current Value is 333 if you would like to show Current Value: 333, you should provide a string Current Value: ${value}

property.caption: currentValuePlaceholderStyle
property.description: Should be provided a placeholder string which will be replaced with current value

property.caption: svgAriaLabel
property.description: SVG aria-label property for Accessibility purposes. Default is "React d3 speedometer"

property.caption: width
property.description: diameter of the speedometer and the width of the svg element. Default is 300.

property.caption: height
property.description: height of the svg element. Height of the speedometer is always half the width since it is a semi-circle. Default is 300.

property.caption: dimension Unit
property.description: Possible values - "em" , "ex" , "px" , "in" , "cm" , "mm" , "pt" , ,"pc". Default is "px" for width/height.

property.caption: fluidWidth
property.description: If true takes the width of the parent component. Default is false.

property.caption: paddingHorizontal
property.description: Provides right/left space for the label text. Takes a number (without explicit unit, unit will be taken from dimensionUnit config which defaults to px). Helpful when using a bigger font size for label texts. Default is 0.

property.caption: paddingVertical
property.description: Provides top/bottom space for the current value label text below the needle. Takes a number (without explicit unit, unit will be taken from dimensionUnit config which defaults to px). Helpful when using a bigger font size for label texts. Default is 0.

property.caption: ringWidth
property.description: Width of the speedometer ring. Default is 60.

property.caption: segments
property.description: Number of segments in the speedometer.

property.caption: maxSegmentLabels
property.description: Limit the number of segment labels to displayed.

property.caption: segmentColors
property.description: Custom segment colors can be given with this option. Should be an array of valid color codes. If this option is given startColor and endColor options will be ignored

property.caption: customSegmentStops
property.description: Array of values starting at min value, and ending at max value. This configuration is useful if you would like to split the segments at custom points or have unequal segments at preferred values. If the values does not begin and end with min and max value respectively, an error will be thrown. This configuration will override segments prop, since total number of segments will be length - 1

property.caption: customSegmentLabels
property.description: Takes an array of CustomSegmentLabel objects. Each object has following keys for custom rendering of labels - text, fontSize, color, position: OUTSIDE/INSIDE.

property.caption: needleColor
property.description: Should be a valid color code - colorname, hexadecimal name or rgb value. Default is "steelblue"

property.caption: startColor
property.description: Should be a valid color code - colorname, hexadecimal name or rgb value. Default is "#FF471A"

property.caption: endColor
property.description: Should be a valid color code - colorname, hexadecimal name or rgb value. Default is "#33CC33"

property.caption: needleTransition
property.description: easeLinear, easeQuadIn, easeQuadOut, easeQuadInOut, easeCubicIn, easeCubicOut, easeCubicInOut, easePolyIn, easePolyOut, easePolyInOut, easeSinIn, easeSinOut, easeSinInOut, easeExpIn, easeExpOut, easeExpInOut, easeCircleIn, easeCircleOut, easeCircleInOut, easeBounceIn, easeBounceOut, easeBounceInOut, easeBackIn, easeBackOut, easeBackInOut, easeElasticIn, easeElasticOut, easeElasticInOut, easeElastic. Default is "easeQuadInOut"

property.caption: needleTransitionDuration
property.description: Time in milliseconds. Default is 500.

property.caption: needleHeightRatio
property.description: Control the height of the needle by giving a decimal between 0 and 1. Default height ratio is 0.9.

property.caption: textColor
property.description: Should be a valid color code - colorname, hexadecimal name or rgb value. Used for both showing the current value and the segment values. Default is #666

property.caption: valueFormat
property.description: should be a valid format for d3-format. By default, no formatter is used. You can use a valid d3 format identifier (for eg: d to convert float to integers), to format the values. Note: This formatter affects all the values (current value, segment values) displayed in the speedometer

property.caption: labelFontSize
property.description: Font size for segment labels/legends. Default is 14px

property.caption: valueTextFontSize
property.description: Font size for current value text. Default is 16px

property.caption: valueTextFontWeight
property.description: Font weight for current value text. Any valid font weight identifier (500, bold etc) can be used. Default is bold
